purpose: Research-only comparison of frozen side-local base/meta state blocks; no automatic production activation.

reference.sampling: immutable UTC beginning/middle/end reference per layer x side

feature_selection.universe: all observable config.py features for the layer; meta additionally admits materialised OOF base score/rank/margin, rolling base reliability/errors, uncertainty, calibration, OOD and drift fields
feature_selection.mda: three chronological folds, economic top10/top20 objective, stable importance = mean - 0.5*std

bhattacharyya_refinement.eligible: top three unpenalized diagonal models with distinct K
bhattacharyya_refinement.early_stop: after two consecutive inferior lambda candidates

probe.raw_feature_basis: one frozen side/layer local Spearman-pruned 40-feature basis reused for all candidates
